name: airband-site
description: airband.harshbaldaniya.com: the Airband website, a static Next.js export

scripts.build: npm run sync && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.next/cache/fetch-cache', { recursive: true, force: true })" && next build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx -y vercel@latest deploy out --prod --yes --project airband
